notes.title: Multiple bugs fixed~
notes.content:
List of bugs fixed:


 Battle and island screens would show upon death, now you are properly shown the Death menu.
 Traps healed the party, now they deal damage.
 Empower Ability would display the wrong card type, now it shows the proper card.
 Leveling Up Dungeons would show the Feast Manor dungeon, now it skips that dungeon.
